sam: quick thread  partner asked how to reconcile reseller-split billing when they resell Redwood-hosted capacity through multiple SI channels. they need deterministic mapping and a proof they can store.
reena: high level: we emit two ledger feeds: PRIMARY_LEDGER (finalized rows) and SHADOW_FEED (per-reseller allocation rows). partners should join on fingerprint + period to reconcile.
oliver: question: how do we compute allocation when a single customer is split across multiple reseller entitlements in the same month? e.g., 70% resale A, 30% resale B.
sam: we store entitlement_allocations per customer per sku with allocation_factor in [0-1]. by default we apply the allocation at finalization time and emit SHADOW_FEED rows with allocated_units = round(usage_units * allocation_factor).
partner-ops: need to know rounding rules and how small remainders are handled across many rows. if multiple rows sum mismatch, do we assign remainder to first reseller or use deterministic hashing?
reena: use deterministic remainder assignment: compute floor for each reseller then assign leftover units to reseller with smallest hashed reseller_id (stable). doc will include pseudocode and a tiny reference script.
finance: also important: fingerprint semantics. SHADOW_FEED fingerprint must be HMAC over canonical_shadow_string = join([customer_id, sku, period_start, period_end, reseller_id, allocated_units], '|'). we will provide key-id header.
marketplace-bot: New ticket created: MP-7602  "shadow-feed-reseller-allocation" (assignee: reena).
oliver: late-arrival/backfill handling: if a backfill increases usage after shadow rows emitted we need to emit a correction row with change_reason=BACKFILL and include changed_from_fingerprint to help partner reconcile programmatically.
partner-ops: partners also asked for a reconciliation_proof bundle: (1) SHADOW_FEED csv for period, (2) PRIMARY_LEDGER csv for same period, (3) sha256 manifest and signatures. this helps auditors.
sam: agree. we'll produce a signed bundle where manifest.json (signed) lists file checksums and key-id. bundle retention: 90 days by default, partners can request extended retention via enterprise plan.
reena: sample SHADOW_FEED CSV header we plan to publish (pipe-delimited):
```
period_start|period_end|customer_id|sku|reseller_id|allocated_units|unit_price_cents|allocated_amount_cents|fingerprint|provisional|change_reason|exported_at_utc
```
and a sample line: `2026-11-01T00:00Z|2026-11-30T23:59Z|cust-ACME-9|api-infer|res-SI-7|210000|3|630000|3f8b6a...|true||2026-11-20T04:12:00Z`
finance: policy: provisional bundle is informative only. credits or invoice adjustments require PRIMARY_LEDGER final rows and the dispute window to close. note this in CSV footer.
oliver: corner-case: what if reseller allocation changes mid-cycle because partner updates contract? we should support allocation_history and emit SHADOW_FEED rows split by allocation periods. docs must show sample for intra-period splits.
partner-ops: action items: reena -> spec + reference script for deterministic remainder; sam -> bundle signing/playbook; oliver -> change_propagation for mid-cycle allocation updates; finance -> wording for provisional vs authoritative and retention.
marketplace-bot: Reminder: partner walkthrough scheduled Fri 09:00 PT.
sam: i'll compile spec and ping ACME-reseller channel once we have draft. thanks all. :thumbsup:
